headline: Auckland new home completions increase steadily this quarter
caption: Great news for East Auckland! New dwelling completions in Auckland have lifted over the March quarter, signalling the building industry is on the road to recovery. This means more housing options and potentially fresher inventory coming into the market — something worth keeping an eye on whether you're buying, selling, or investing. 🏡
original_title: Number of new homes being completed in Auckland increased steadily over the March quarter
